metadata.title: The Three Little Pigs
metadata.subtitle: Three Houses and One Big Huff
metadata.author: Giggle & Snooze
metadata.blurb: Three little pigs build three little houses. When a wolf comes huffing down the lane, the house built one careful brick at a time has room for all three.
metadata.dedication: For little builders and the people they make room for.

style_bible.style_prompt_prefix: Hand-printed linocut picture-book illustration on oat paper, rounded carved silhouettes, tactile ink grain, broad color shapes, expressive little pigs, gentle afternoon light.

characters.name: Pip
characters.look: Pip is a small round pink pig with two brown eyes, a freckled snout, and sunshine-yellow overalls.

characters.name: Poppy
characters.look: Poppy is a round peach-pink pig with two brown eyes, one floppy ear, and a leaf-green shirt.

characters.name: Pebble
characters.look: Pebble is a sturdy rose-pink pig with two brown eyes, a white patch over one ear, and blue overalls.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.look: Wolf is a lanky slate-gray wolf with two amber eyes, a cream muzzle, rounded ears, and a rust-red scarf.

pages.title: Three Little Builders
pages.text: Pip, Poppy, and Pebble set out to build houses. They walked down the same sunny lane so they could live close enough to wave.
pages.prompt: Pip, Poppy, and Pebble pull little wagons of straw, sticks, and bricks along a curving lane, with three nearby plots in the sunny meadow.

pages.title: Straw for Pip
pages.text: Pip stacked straw, bundle by bundle. The bundles were light, so by snack time Pip had a house!
pages.prompt: Pip pats the last yellow bundle onto a low straw house, with a snack apple beside the doorstep and open sky at upper right.

pages.title: Sticks for Poppy
pages.text: Poppy tied sticks, bundle by bundle. The sticks made a shady roof, so Poppy ate lunch on the doorstep.
pages.prompt: Poppy sits in the striped shade of a little stick house with visible rope ties, holding a sandwich, with open sky at upper left.

pages.title: Bricks for Pebble
pages.text: Pebble laid bricks, one by one. When a brick wobbled, Pebble set it straight. By teatime, even the tallest wall stood steady.
pages.prompt: Pebble checks a straight row of warm red bricks with a small wooden level beside the nearly finished brick cottage in golden afternoon light.

pages.title: Room for Three
pages.text: Pebble fitted the door, then slid the bolt across. Click! Inside, Pebble set out three cushions so there would be room for everyone.
pages.prompt: Pebble arranges three plump cushions on a bench inside the brick cottage, with the simple door bolt visible and open wall space at upper right.

pages.title: A Huff at the Straw House
pages.text: Wolf huffed, and the straw flew up like dry leaves. Scamper, scamper! Pip ran next door, and Poppy opened the door wide.
pages.prompt: Wolf stands by straw bundles drifting onto the grass while Pip reaches Poppy at the open stick-house door just a few steps away. The pigs are close together and Wolf looks surprised.

pages.title: A Huff at the Stick House
pages.text: Wolf huffed, and the sticks clattered down like wooden spoons. Scamper, scamper! Pip and Poppy ran to Pebble, who tucked them inside and slid the bolt. Click!
pages.prompt: Loose sticks lie on the grass near Wolf on the left. On the right, Pip and Poppy are both inside the brick cottage with Pebble at the door, the sliding bolt visible from the interior.

pages.title: A Huff at the Brick House
pages.text: Wolf huffed, and the grass bent low. Wolf puffed, and the scarf fluttered. The bricks stayed put, and the three little pigs stayed snug.
pages.prompt: View from the brick cottage interior. Pip, Poppy, and Pebble sit shoulder to shoulder on their cushions beside a window showing Wolf blowing outside, rust-red scarf fluttering and grasses bent. Leave quiet wall space at upper left.

pages.title: Down the Lane
pages.text: Wolf's cheeks grew tired. The bricks stayed put, so Wolf wrapped up in the scarf and went home. From the window, three little pigs watched Wolf disappear around the bend.
pages.prompt: Wolf strolls away along the curving lane, scarf wrapped comfortably, while Pip, Poppy, and Pebble peek through the cottage window. Open golden sky at upper right.

pages.title: Snug Together
pages.text: Pip poured the tea, Poppy passed the toast, and Pebble scooted over. Tomorrow they could build together, brick by brick. Tonight there was room for three.
pages.prompt: Pip pours tea from a little pot, Poppy passes a plate of toast, and Pebble makes space on the cushioned bench. Warm lamplight fills the brick cottage, with quiet wall space at upper left.
